# captured 2026-09-22
# exe: /home/ubuntu/.local/bin/git-town
# args: 
Branching and workflow support for Git.

Git Town helps create, sync, and ship changes
efficiently and with minimal merge conflicts.

Usage:
  git-town [flags]
  git-town [command]

Basic workflow:
  hack        Create a new feature branch off the main branch
  propose     Create a proposal to merge a feature branch
  sync        Update the current branch with all relevant changes

Stacked changes:
  append      Create a new feature branch as a child of the current branch
  combine     Combines the current branch with its parent
  commit      Commit into another branch
  detach      Move a branch out of a stack
  diff-parent Show the changes committed to a branch
  prepend     Create a new feature branch as the parent of the current branch
  set-parent  Set the parent branch for the current branch
  swap        Swap the position of this branch with its parent

Branch navigation:
  branch      Display the local branch hierarchy and types
  down        Switch to the child branch
  switch      Switch branches visually
  up          Switch to the parent branch

Control syncing:
  contribute  Stop syncing some feature branches with their parents
  feature     Convert branches to feature branches
  observe     Stop your contributions to some feature branches
  park        Suspend syncing of some feature branches
  prototype   Make an existing branch a prototype branch

Error handling:
  continue    Resume the last run Git Town command after having resolved conflicts
  runlog      Displays the repo state before and after previous Git Town commands
  skip        Resume the last run Git Town command by skipping the current branch
  status      Displays or resets the current suspended Git Town command
  undo        Undo the most recent Git Town command

Configuration:
  completions Generate auto-completion for bash, zsh, fish, or PowerShell
  config      Display your Git Town configuration
  init        Set up Git Town on your computer
  offline     Display or set offline mode

Additional Commands:
  compress    Squash all commits on the current branch down to a single commit
  delete      Remove an obsolete feature branch
  help        Help about any command
  rename      Rename a branch and its tracking branch
  repo        Open the repository homepage in the browser
  ship        Deliver a completed feature branch
  walk        Run a command on each local feature branch

Flags:
  -h, --help      help for git-town
  -V, --version   display the version number

Use "git-town [command] --help" for more information about a command.
